# Catto Learning Theme SDK

**Generated by:** ChatGPT  
**Date time:** 2026/08/12 02:45 SAST  
**LMS version:** 0.5.4

The Theme SDK is the authoring contract plus tools for creating portable Theme Package 1.0 themes. It consists of the package specification, JSON Schema, starter theme, validator/importer, exporter and scaffold generator.

## Generate a starter theme

```bash
php tools/generate-theme.php "My Theme"
```

The generator writes a new folder under `generated-themes/`. Add `--zip` to also create an importable ZIP:

```bash
php tools/generate-theme.php "My Theme" --zip
```

## Authoring workflow

1. Generate or copy the starter theme.
2. Edit `theme.json` metadata.
3. Build the base template and optional partial/page overrides with F3 template syntax.
4. Add at least one stylesheet.
5. Add browser JavaScript only when required.
6. Put images/fonts under an asset folder and explicitly declare them.
7. Declare HTTPS CDN links in `theme.json`, not implicitly in templates.
8. ZIP the package with `theme.json` at root.
9. Administration → Themes → Import Theme ZIP.
10. Review validation/inspection, import as draft, preview, then Activate.

## Visual Theme Studio

Theme Studio edits semantic roles rather than destructively rewriting CSS. It covers palettes, semantic colours, contrast checks, Inter/Plus Jakarta Sans/Satoshi/system typography, navigation position/size/order/visibility/stickiness/separator, context bar, content width/spacing/card presentation, footer, front-page hero and device preview.

To make a custom theme respond to structure controls, use the documented `data-theme-*` hooks. Advanced Custom CSS remains the final override layer.

## Automatic safe contrast

Foreground semantic roles such as navigation text, body text, breadcrumbs, hero text and primary-button text may use **Automatic safe contrast**. Catto Learning selects a dark or light foreground from the effective background instead of assuming white will be readable. Administrators may still override the role with a palette swatch or custom colour.

## Gradient-capable presentation

Theme Studio palette and semantic-role fields remain explicit hexadecimal colours. Theme CSS and Advanced Custom CSS may use deliberate CSS gradients for decorative effects. The Aurum Learning package is the reference example for metallic gilt treatments.

## Page templates

Only `templates/base.html` is mandatory. Header/footer/sidebar and special page templates are optional. This lets minimal themes stay small while sophisticated themes can override selected LMS surfaces. Missing page overrides fall back to Catto Learning's standard page template.

## PHP and application logic

Do not put PHP in a theme. If a future presentation feature genuinely needs trusted server code, it belongs in an LMS extension/plugin with a separate security/install boundary, not in an ordinary theme ZIP.


## Core palette chooser

Every Catto Learning theme receives the platform palette chooser automatically. A theme manifest supplies the palettes; the LMS supplies the chooser UI, hide/unhide behaviour and per-browser preference persistence. Theme packages must not remove or replace this core control.

Theme Studio uses typed six-digit hexadecimal values rather than the operating-system colour picker.
